title: Diffusion-Based Data Augmentation and Knowledge Distillation With Generated Soft Labels for Oil Spill Segmentation Learning on Satellite SAR Images (DAKTer)
mechanism: Diffusion jointly generates images and soft-label maps, with an SNR-based factor aligning noise across the two modalities; a student segmenter learns from soft labels.
adaptation: Joint pixel-space generation of (EL, p_crack band about 4 px wide, p_inactive); soft crack labels match the jittered line; student trained on real hard + generated soft labels.
min_experiment: PF student with generated soft-label pairs vs PF. Metric test crack relF1@2 and IoU at val-chosen bias. Kill: both gains < +0.005.
evidence: R: scarce SAR oil-spill data; better than other generative augmentation methods across several segmenters (abstract gives no numbers).
prior_overlap: Offset-tolerant CE (n.d.) changed the loss on real labels; generated soft-label pairs are untested. Open.
